subject: Clarification on SOC 2 report window, timezone boundaries, and prior-period exceptions
messages:
From: AuditOps LLC <auditops@example.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement - BrightEdge <procurement@brightedge.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on SOC 2 Type II reporting window and timezone boundaries

Hi Rishi,

We're preparing the SOC 2 Type II request packet for BrightEdge and had a couple of clarifying questions before we finalize the evidence list:  

1) Report window inclusivity: your published SOC 2 report is dated "Period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31". For BrightEdge's security assessment, can you confirm whether the report is inclusive of activity through 2025-12-31 23:59 UTC, or if you apply a specific timezone (e.g., PST) when determining the end-of-period cutoff?  

2) Point-in-time checks: For point-in-time control evidence (e.g., access lists, firewall snapshots), do you normally provide a snapshot as of the report end date, or do you provide the most recent pre-audit snapshot (commonly Oct/Nov) and then a bridge letter for any changes between snapshot and report end?

3) Prior-period exceptions: BrightEdge's procurement team asked whether any exceptions from prior audit periods were carried forward that could affect the current Type II coverage. If there are prior exceptions, can you summarize whether they were remediated before the current testing window or carried forward? 

We would appreciate a short note and — if available — a draft bridge letter to share with BrightEdge. Attaching a short list of items BrightEdge typically requests for evidence; we'll follow up with any additional specifics.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Audit Engagement Manager
AuditOps LLC
(Attachment: evidence_checklist_auditops.csv)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: AuditOps LLC <auditops@example.com>
Cc: procurement@brightedge.com, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on SOC 2 Type II reporting window and timezone boundaries

Hi Laura — thanks for the questions and for looping in BrightEdge. Quick answers up front, and then a couple of follow-ups so we provide exactly what you need.

1) End-of-period cutoff: Our SOC 2 Type II report covers activity through 2025-12-31 23:59:59 PST (UTC-8). Historically we state the period in local time (PST) because our evidence collection and point-in-time snapshots use servers and logging configured in our primary US region. We can provide a UTC timestamp mapping if BrightEdge prefers that view.

2) Point-in-time evidence: For controls that require a snapshot, our standard practice is to provide the snapshot taken closest to the end date (we generally capture a snapshot on the last business day of the month). If the snapshot is older than the end date, we supply a bridge letter describing any material changes between the snapshot and the report cutoff.

3) Prior-period exceptions: There were two minor control deviations reported in the prior Type II period (2024) related to a patching exception that was remediated and tested during the 2025 period. No carry-forward exceptions that would materially affect 2025 coverage; we can provide the remediation summary and test results.

Attachments: I am attaching our public SOC 2 report (redwood_soc2_type2_public_report_2025.pdf) and a draft bridge letter for your review (bridge_letter_draft.docx).

Follow-ups: 
- Laura, can you confirm whether BrightEdge's assessor needs UTC-based timestamps instead of PST?
- Procurement team: are you comfortable accepting a bridge letter plus the last-business-day snapshot, or do you require a new point-in-time export taken specifically for BrightEdge as of 2025-12-31? If the latter, we'll coordinate a short one-off export (may take 48-72 hours).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_public_report_2025.pdf; bridge_letter_draft.docx)

From: AuditOps LLC <auditops@example.com>

Cc: procurement@brightedge.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on SOC 2 Type II reporting window and timezone boundaries

Thanks Rishi — that is helpful. BrightEdge's assessor prefers evidence tied to UTC where possible, but they will accept PST if we supply a clear mapping and a signed statement of the cutoff timezone. A couple of follow-ups:  

- Can you add the exact filename and path for the last-business-day snapshot exports (e.g., audit/access_list_2025-12-30.csv) so the assessor can reference them in their testing workpapers?
- On the prior-period patching deviation: can you confirm the remediation date and provide the test artifact that shows the patch was applied and validated (screenshot or ticket export is fine).

We reviewed the draft bridge letter and proposed a couple of edits (embedded as comments in the Word doc). Overall looks good but we suggest tightening the language around "material change" to avoid ambiguity. I will attach a redlined bridge letter and a short checklist for the BrightEdge assessor.

Best,
Laura Chen
Audit Engagement Manager
AuditOps LLC
(Attachments: bridge_letter_redline.docx; assessor_checklist_brightedge.pdf)

Thanks Laura — and thanks Rishi for the draft. A few internal notes and confirmation of next steps: 

- I'll generate the point-in-time exports and name them as follows:

  - audit/firewall_rules_2025-12-30.csv (network control snapshot)
  - audit/patch_tickets_2025-11-18.csv (patch remediation evidence)
